G2384G.name: Jacob
G2384G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G2384G.brief: Father of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
G2384G.short: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

G2383.name: Jairus
G2383.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2383.brief: Synagogue leader whose daughter Jesus healed
G2383.short: Jairus, a synagogue leader, sought Jesus to heal his dying daughter.

G2387.name: Jambres
G2387.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2387.short: Jambres was an Egyptian magician who, along with Jannes, opposed Moses.

G2385J.name: James
G2385J.desc: Father of an apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G2385J.short: James, father of Judas who was also know as Thaddaeus, one of the Twelve Apostles chosen by Jesus.

G2385H.name: James
G2385H.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G2385H.short: James son of Alphaeus, known as "James the Less"was one of the Twelve Apostles.

G2385I.name: James
G2385I.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2385I.brief: Jesus' brother, leader in the Jerusalem church
G2385I.short: James, the brother of Jesus, was a leader in the Jerusalem church and authored the epistle of James.

G2385G.name: James
G2385G.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G2385G.brief: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles
G2385G.short: James, son of Zebedee and brother of John, was one of the Twelve Apostles and a member of Jesus' inner circle.

G2388.name: Jannai
G2388.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G2388.brief: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
G2388.short: Jannai was an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

G2389.name: Jannes
G2389.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2389.short: Jannes was an Egyptian magician who, along with Jambres, opposed Moses.

G2394.name: Jason
G2394.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2394.brief: Paul's host in Thessalonica; relative of Paul
G2394.short: Jason was Paul's host in Thessalonica and a relative of Paul mentioned in his letter to the Romans.

G2321.name: Theophilus
G2321.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2321.brief: Recipient of Luke's Gospel and Acts
G2321.short: Theophilus was the recipient of Luke's Gospel and the Book of Acts, likely a Christian of high social standing.

G2333.name: Theudas
G2333.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2333.brief: Jewish rebel leader killed by Roman authorities
G2333.short: Theudas was a Jewish rebel leader who was killed, and his followers scattered, by the Roman authorities.

G2381.name: Thomas
G2381.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G2381.brief: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting
G2381.short: Thomas, also called Didymus, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting Jesus' resurrection until he saw him in person.

G2332.name: Thessalonica
G2332.brief: Macedonian city, site of an early Christian church
G2332.short: Thessalonica, a prominent city in Macedonia, where Paul established a church and wrote two epistles to the believers (<ref="Act.17.1-9; 1Thess. 1:1; 2Thess. 1:1">Act.17.1-9; 1Thess. 1:1; 2Thess. 1:1</ref>).

G2363.name: Thyatira
G2363.brief: City in Asia Minor, home of the prophet Lydia
G2363.short: Thyatira, a city in Asia Minor, known for its dyeing industry and the home of Lydia, a convert of Paul (<ref="Act.16.14; Rev. 1:11; 2:18, 24">Act.16.14; Rev. 1:11; 2:18, 24</ref>).
